description: This file defines the 'ExpressionFactory' class, which provides parsing capabilities for macro expressions in the source code. It includes methods to parse macro blocks (like #if, #else, #end), tokenize macro lines, and generate expression objects used for macro evaluation within the project.

classes.name: ExpressionFactory
classes.description: A singleton utility class that provides static methods to parse macro expressions from strings.

classes.name: ExpressionFactory.MacroReader
classes.description: Helper class to read macro blocks from strings, handling multiple markers and internal buffering.

classes.name: ExpressionFactory.Buffer
classes.description: Internal class used to accumulate characters during token creation, and identify token boundaries.

methods.name: parseMacro
methods.description: Parses a string containing macro directives (#if ... #end) and builds a Macro object with sub-expressions.

methods.name: parseMacroLine
methods.description: Parses a single macro line (e.g., #if, #elseif, #else, #end) into a MacroExpression object.

methods.name: createExpression
methods.description: Creates a composite Expression object from a list of tokens, supporting nested groups and logical operators.
